en: The front of the postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a waterfront settlement with a prominent church or tower-like structure, surrounded by other substantial buildings and forest in the background. The water in the foreground suggests a river or lake. There is handwritten text in Swedish on the bottom half of the image and a caption identifying the place. The back of the postcard has a printed heading in Swedish ('BREFKORT'), French ('Carte postale'), a green Swedish stamp, and handwritten recipient information.
